title: CompactDoc
description: The compact encoding used as the editor model. Three node forms: a typed node, a literal, and a name reference. Sequence position is the only ordering: order and argumentIndex are derivable from the arrays here and are materialized in the RDF projection instead, where position cannot be recovered. Required fields are rebuilt by the decoder, so this form does not carry them.

@type.description: A syntax node type such as While, or, for a collapsed constructor, the class name as a bare term followed by any declared co-types. The JSON-LD keyword rather than a plain word because a node carries its fields as sibling keys and AST field names are arbitrary identifiers: ExceptHandler has a field called type.

span.description: Optional [lineno, col, endLineno, endCol]; the join key for the editor, the trace overlay and in-place patching. Needed only to patch the original file, not to regenerate code.

oneOf.description: A typed node: a syntax node, or a collapsed constructor carrying its fields directly.
